يستلبون (form VIII)
# يَسْتَلِبُونَ (yastalibūna) /jas.ta.li.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# يُسْتَلَبُونَ (yustalabūna) /jus.ta.la.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
